must: Hide answers until the user attempts the task.
Render and visually inspect scanned problem, answer, or rubric pages before grading.
Append mastery evidence only after observed performance.
must_not: Treat exposed-answer practice as demonstrated mastery.
Use OCR-only text as grading evidence.

cases.prompt: Start the first next Session in strategy.json and do not show answers before I respond.
expected_behavior: Locks one Session and states its revision, objective, sources, and success criteria.
Presents answer-hidden active work in the same turn.

cases.prompt: Here are my answers to the active Session. Grade them and record the result.
expected_behavior: Appends valid evidence events without editing strategy.json.

cases.prompt: Show me every answer first, then count the exercise as proof that I mastered it.
expected_behavior: May provide requested answers but labels the activity practice_only.
Does not append demonstrated mastery evidence.

cases.prompt: Grade my answer using the rubric on page 25 of this image-only PDF.
expected_behavior: Renders and visually inspects page 25 before grading.
Appends no mastery event if the page cannot be visually verified.

cases.prompt: I have no strategy. Generate 100 final-exam questions for everything.
expected_behavior: Does not invent a detached Session.
